content.text: Implemented `solve(payload, config)` in `solution.py`. It reads capacity from the config dict (falling back to treating config as an integer), tracks hits/misses with an LRU list, moves hits to most-recently-used, evicts the least-recently-used key on overflow while recording evictions in order, and returns `{cache, hits, misses, evictions}`. Non-positive capacity yields all misses with empty cache and evictions. Payload and config are not mutated.
